function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The raw difference in response rates between females and males is confounded by baseline severity: females are overrepresented in milder severity categories, which are associated with higher response rates, while males are overrepresented in severe categories, which are associated with lower response rates. This means the observed difference in response rates is not attributable to sex alone. To address this, I computed a severity-adjusted response rate for each sex using the overall severity distribution in the treatment arm as weights. This provides a fairer comparison by removing the influence of the severity imbalance."}
